item.title: Wrong Copying Progress and Long Disk Unmounting on Ubuntu
item.description: Sometimes I need to copy files from an internal SSD to an external hard drive. Recently I’ve found a strange behavior on Ubuntu 20.04. When I try to copy a fairly big file (like 2Gb - 4Gb) Nautilus shows insane writing speed and the progress bar instantly reaches 100%, but when I want to unmount the device - it freezes for several minutes. I tried different file managers like Thunar from Xfce, midnight-commander, or even utilities like rsync or pv - the result was the same. For me, it’s a bit inconvenient when I don’t know how much time I have to wait until all data will be transferred, so I tried to find the solution to this problem.
